content: Hey Matt, What are you doing here?
I called your house and your brother told me you'd be here, nice jacket.
Thanks, it's a present from the baseball team.
They're going to miss you. You're their star player.
I wasn't. Today we lost, 22 to 2.
Ouch. I think we need to have a talk.
Look. If it's about my decision to go to New York. I'm not going to change my mind.
But I'll be back to visit and you can come and see me.
Now let's not kid ourselves. Four years in New York will pretty much end our relationship.
Lots of people have long distance relationships.
Not me. I'm not a long distance kind of guy, all our friends are getting married, they're having kids, I thought we were the next.
